subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Week 8: introduces /t/ (tap, tiger, not, spot); differentiates t and s; teacher models segmenting and blending (tap, sat, mat)

show.line: Listen. t, t, tap. t, t, tiger! Tap and tiger start with t.

rounds.prompt: Which one starts with t, as in tiger?
Say the sound with me. t, as in tap!
Is it s or t? Listen. Tiger.
Listen. s, a, t. What word is it?
Listen. m, a, t. What word is it?
Does it start with t or s? Sort the pictures.

hints: t is a short sound. Tap your tongue. t, t, t.
Say the sounds fast. s, a, t. Sat!

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will put the sounds together. t, a, p.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! t, a, p makes tap.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's do it together. t, a, p. Tap!

parent_line: Can hear the t sound and blend short words like sat, mat and tap.
